page_text:
mwe.com

Paul W. Hughes
Attorney at Law
phughes@mwe.com
+1 202 756 8981

July 11, 2019 

BY HAND DELIVERY 

Scott S. Harris, Clerk 
Supreme Court of the United States 
One First Street NE 
Washington, DC 20543 

Re:  Guerrero-Lasprilla v. Barr, No. 18-776; and 

Ovalles v. Barr, No. 18-1015 

Dear Mr. Harris: 

I  represent  petitioners  in  the  above-captioned  cases.  On  behalf  of  petitioners  and 

respondent in the two consolidated cases, I write to propose the following briefing schedule:  

Petitioners’ brief due:  
August 29, 2019 
Respondent’s brief due:   October 21, 2019 

Petitioners and respondent have agreed to this proposed schedule, which would allow the 

Court to hold oral argument as early as the December 2019 sitting. 

Please let me know if you have any questions or need any additional information. 

Thank you for your assistance. 

Sincerely, 

__________________________ 
Paul W. Hughes 

CC: Counsel for respondent 

500 North Capitol Street, NW   Washington DC 20001-1531   Tel +1 202 756 8000   Fax +1 202 756 8087 

US practice conducted through McDermott Will & Emery LLP.
